title: Separably generated field extensions have zero first cotangent homology
statement: Let $k\subseteq E$ be a separably generated extension of fields [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension] (1): there is a transcendence basis $(t_i)_{i\in I}$ of $E/k$ such that $E/k(t_i;i\in I)$ is separable algebraic. Then $H_1(L_{E/k})=0$, where $H_1(L_{E/k})$ is the kernel of the naive cotangent differential for the canonical polynomial presentation $k[E]\to E$ [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. There is no finite-generation or characteristic restriction.
